follow-up time: Immediate, from pre- to post-skin-to-skin contact
exposure: Early intraoperative skin-to-skin contact (SSC) after elective cesarean birth
outcome: Newborn axillary temperature change from pre- to post-skin-to-skin contact
cohort: 91 mother-baby dyads who participated in early intraoperative SSC after an elective cesarean birth
finding: While there was variation in temperature change observed, this study supports continued research on intraoperative skin-to-skin contact after elective cesarean birth.
mod_finding: Study specifically investigated the effects of skin-to-skin contact after cesarean birth.
